The '''Confederation Fleet''' was the [[Navy/Legends|naval]] branch of the [[Confederation]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

==Supreme Commander==
*The [[Supreme Commander of the Confederation military|Supreme Commander]] of the Confederation Fleet was former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]].
